desc: Implement K=2 case: divide-and-conquer maximum XOR pair (O(N log MAX), O(N) memory).
Implement K≥3 case: verify C(N,K) ≤ 1e6, then brute-force with itertools.combinations.
Read input from stdin, dispatch to correct case based on K, print the result.
Test with provided sample inputs (Sample 1, Sample 2).
Test edge cases: N=1 K=1; N=2 K=2; large N (e.g., 200000) with K=2; K=3 with N=182; K=22 with N=22.
Verify performance and memory usage for K=2 with N=200000 (should be within time and memory limits).
